saved.name: Rate base: plant, used and useful, prudence
saved.prompt: Marc needs the Belmara rate base for the BPUC by Friday 30 October. Work out what we have invested in plant, pipes and treatment, net of depreciation, at the 31 December 2026 test year end; show that the additions were prudent and are used and useful; and draft the rate base schedules in the 2025 structure, a prudence and used-and-useful memo, and a few slides for the working session with BPUC staff on 4 November. Attached: the 2025 rate base schedules and the BPUC post-test-year schedule.
steps: State plant in service and depreciation by class
Test what is used and useful at 31 December
Roll the rate base forward from the 2025 order
Check the prudence record of the major additions
Draft the schedules, the memo and the slides

saved.name: Off-framework orders: size, cause, options
saved.prompt: Help me take 2.5% off procurement spend across all our capital projects. Check every new order line against the framework agreements and benchmark prices, tell me when something goes off-framework or above benchmark, and work out what can still be done before I ask.
steps: Confirm what the order load flagged, and size it
Why it happened, and whether anyone raised it
Trace each line against its framework price
What can still be done, including nothing
Note to the people you chose
